sections.title: CONCLUSION
sections.text_preview: Recent advances in MMIC designs for 60-GHz front-end circuits like VCOs, wideband ampliﬁers, and frequency multipliers based on GaAs-based PHEMTs and MHEMTs as well as Si CMOS technologies are described. PHEMT-based VCOs were optimized for low phase noise, thus showing the feasibility of frequency-generation MMICs for 60-GHz front-ends based on a PHEMT process.
